name: Hotmart API
description: The Hotmart API provides access to Hotmart's digital product platform services including sales, subscriptions, products, members area (club), coupons, tickets, payment links, and account management. All operations use resource-oriented URLs with HTTP methods (GET, POST, PUT, PATCH, DELETE) and return JSON responses.
